method: Every discovered dist/game/**/*.test.mjs module executed directly as a separate Node process; up to four concurrently. Actual final per-module Node summary parsed.
launch_method: Python subprocess pipe bridge; one actual Node process per module; stdout/stderr combined before relay
invocation_diagnosis: On this execution host direct Node-to-Node pipe children suppress JavaScript stdout, including console.log; --version alone does not detect the issue. A Python-owned subprocess pipe capture and relay preserves the actual test output. No aggregate --test module counts are used.
